$comment: Curated name-agreement decisions for direct seed↔NSE-listing symbol matches (audit round 4, Q3).
A direct match counts only if lib/db/nameAgreement.agreesEnough() passes OR a reviewed entry exists here with sources.
WRONG_BINDING/BIND_WITH_OVERRIDE — binding accepted (seed name kept: recognizable market name).
RENAMED/UPDATE_SEED_NAME — binding accepted and the seed record now carries the official name.
WRONG_BINDING/REMOVE_SEED_RECORD — the seed record was removed from data/stocks/index.ts; the official listing row is untouched.
Official names are pinned to the committed CSV snapshot (primary source, sha256 above). Founders/auditors re-verify via the NSE quote URLs.
Schema is validated by lib/db/nameAgreement.parseNameOverrides; staleness is checked by validateSecurityMaster V7.
